name: Can accessibility modifications be built into a standard room renovation?

mainEntity.name: Can accessibility modifications be built into a standard room renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can modify rooms with targeted accessibility improvements like widening interior doorways, eliminating floor transitions, and adding reinforcement framing behind drywall for grab bars. These improvements can blend seamlessly with finish carpentry, custom molding, and modern tile designs without looking institutional. If you anticipate aging in place or accommodating family members with mobility challenges, planning these structural adjustments during a remodel avoids the expense of tearing open finished walls later on. HH Remodeling handles accessibility modifications alongside standard room remodels.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, contractors can widen doorways, remove trip hazards, and frame wall supports for grab bars during a renovation while maintaining your preferred design aesthetic.
